main.description: Create a ref (branch / tag / HEAD) pointing to an initial commit. Ref names are unique per (ownerDid, kind).

ownerDid.description: Actor DID that owns this ref (= Repository identity per ADR-0039).

refName.description: Branch/tag name. Slashes allowed (e.g. 'feat/new-block'). 'HEAD' reserved for kind=head.

kind.description: branch = mutable via updateRef; tag = immutable (updateRef rejects); head = symbolic pointer to another branch.

initialCommit.description: commitHash this ref starts pointing at. Required for branch/tag; symbolic target for head.

errors.name: ReservedName
errors.description: Ref name collides with a reserved symbol (e.g. 'HEAD' with kind != head).
